blocks.text: This year's YouTube Music Weekend was held on April 6 and 7, featuring Reine, Ollie, Risu, and Calli. Unlike last year, there were no hololive JP members participating.

As her first performance for this event, Reine got the party started on April 6 with a 43-minute DJ set in VRChat with a 3D model by Priichu. She demonstrated skillful transitions between songs across all hololive branches (including her own), simultaneously singing throughout! Afterwards came Ollie, who sang holopro songs- translated to Indonesian by herself.
The next day, April 7, featured Risu doing karaoke with her (official) home 3D model, then Calli sang her greatest hits in her party outfit and promoted her upcoming major debut EP, SHINIGAMI NOTE.
